milestones.title: Foundation and discovery
milestones.delivered: Original articles, six topics, search, reading lists and a selected timeline.
milestones.next: Continue to maintain links, accessibility and source attribution.

milestones.title: Unified site-wide navigation
milestones.delivered: Explore, Scripture, Research and Project menus expose every major public hub on desktop and mobile.
milestones.next: Recheck keyboard, touch and small-screen behaviour after navigation changes.

milestones.title: Biblical primary-text collection
milestones.delivered: Local Bible reader, named-reference index and 26 original guides with explicit passage references.
milestones.next: Add careful textual comparison and qualified specialist review where applicable.

milestones.title: Encyclopaedia expansion and preservation
milestones.delivered: Preserved reference corpus, expanded original introductions, glossary and measurable expansion dashboard.
milestones.next: Prioritise deeper original articles and verify copyright, provenance and scope of preserved texts.

milestones.title: Interactive historical atlas
milestones.delivered: Eleven dated interpretive sketches, timeline controls, modern geography and reproducible offline validation.
milestones.next: Strengthen geographic uncertainty, dated boundary evidence and connections to individual articles.

milestones.title: Section-level source traceability
milestones.delivered: Evidence Register, reversible source-to-guide links and 101 section reading trails across 41 guides.
milestones.next: Extend section coverage without treating section links as proof of all contained claims.

milestones.title: Historical claim verification
milestones.delivered: Initial 15 text-anchored claim records with direct passages, source roles, qualifications and an independent-review queue.
milestones.next: Check inscription or tablet identifiers and exact editions, reconcile conflicting reports and record qualified expert decisions.

milestones.title: Assyrian languages and cultural heritage
milestones.delivered: Introductory language and heritage entries provide starting context.
milestones.next: Add specialist-reviewed Akkadian, Syriac and Neo-Aramaic material with licensed audio and transliteration.

milestones.title: Community testimony and heritage media
milestones.delivered: Local Markdown contribution drafts can be downloaded without transmitting personal data.
milestones.next: Plan consent, permissions, moderated interviews, village histories and media preservation.

milestones.title: Secure contribution delivery
milestones.delivered: Dormant backend is retained and public contributions remain download-only.
milestones.next: Authorise a project-specific sender or Microsoft Graph integration, then verify privacy, anti-abuse controls and genuine end-to-end delivery.

milestones.title: Editorial governance and revision history
milestones.delivered: Contributor guidance and deterministic metadata validation exist.
milestones.next: Define named reviewers, corrections, record revision provenance, moderation and multilingual editorial workflows.

milestones.title: Publication and long-term stewardship
milestones.delivered: Static deployment, offline validation and explicit indexing controls are established.
milestones.next: Complete specialist review, browser and accessibility testing, licence checks and deliberate indexing approval.
